behaviors.behavior: an explicit profile in the brief wins over the persistence inference and is passed on unchanged
an unknown or invalid name is reported (profile null, profile_error, warnings, exit 3) and never replaced
a brief without a profile behaves as before; adopt stays green
project and user profiles resolve through the resolver; profile file contents are untrusted
the WebUI one-line Stack profile trailer and text keys are read with deterministic precedence
brief file to intake CLI to write-config to run config to next step carries the named profile
the fixture-approval refusal says only the operator may set the switch
the reserved placeholder 'detecting' is refused as invalid while 'generic' is accepted
a free-text 'Profile: ...' line stays in the description; resolver messages lose control, C1 and bidi characters
an idea with its own Intake look-alike cannot name the profile: the trailer is the last one and ends the text; two trailers or two Stack profile items are refused
bare profile words in a text brief (bulleted, none, unknown) stay prose; a misspelled Stack profile key exits 3
a brief naming no profile never loads the profile module; a missing module or unexpected resolver failure is resolver_unavailable only when a profile is named
an unused bare profile: hint adds a sanitised non-blocking warning (exit 0, line kept, inference stays) and briefs with no profile line gain no new key
one precedence rule over the profile sources: JSON field, text Stack profile key, last trailer, then only the bare hint; a hint never masks a strict source (table-driven)

final round: a one-line wizard brief whose idea starts with a brief key keeps its trailer profile; (Intake forms)/stack profile: prose in the idea no longer refuses; duplicate Stack profile lines are ambiguous; every resolver error kind of a bare hint is a warning; the case-insensitive gate, the sanitised refusal shape of a failed sibling load and the untrusted-resolver prefix hold

round 6: prose that is not a trailer is never refused (warned), the earlier-trailer pattern is linear (200 KB input), a text Stack profile key that disagrees with the trailer is ambiguous, a prose-only mention of profiles never fails on a missing module, a generic resolver failure on a hint warns, a misplaced/lower-case trailer is reported, stackProfile-like JSON keys warn, private parser keys in JSON briefs are dropped

round 7: a valid multi-line brief naming one profile is not refused (one-line text only, no value spans a newline); a fence inside an idea does not replace the brief; the Stack profile line stays in the description; a misplaced trailer warns beside a hint; the key-line and fence regexes are linear; the exact WebUI one-liner with a project profile reaches the run config

round 8: the wizard trailer is read only from the last physical line of the raw text; prose that only looks like a trailer is neither refused nor warned; the original unanchored fence is restored (no-profile briefs parse as before B2b) except when the last line is a wizard trailer; text key and trailer conflicts are checked in both orders; a swallowed-key trailer on the last line is read

surface_verification.runner: uv run --extra dev pytest shared/tests/test_brief_profile.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
